summary: Iteration 6 (Native IAP scaffolding + Asset Version History + Offline core) backend + frontend testing PASSED. Backend (10/10 in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py, 21s): (1) GET /api/payments/iap/products returns exactly two products — {product_id:'pro.monthly', plan:'monthly', amount:14.99} and {product_id:'pro.yearly', plan:'yearly', amount:149}. (2) POST /api/payments/iap/verify — no auth returns 401; unknown product_id -> 400; ios missing receipt -> 400 (contains 'receipt'); ios with dummy 'receipt' -> 503 with body 'Verification failed (apple_not_configured)' because APPLE_SHARED_SECRET is empty (spec-matched); android missing purchase_token -> 400. (3) Asset version-history full flow on a THROWAWAY account (exactly 2 image generations consumed): register user -> create project -> create brand-kit (auto_generate, Claude palette only, no image gen) -> POST /api/assets/generate (gen #1) returns asset with versions=[] -> GET /api/assets/{id}/versions returns {asset_id, type, current:{id:'current', image_b64:<b64>, prompt, watermarked}, versions:[]} -> POST /api/assets/{id}/regenerate (gen #2) returns {asset, newly_unlocked, streak_event:{count,extended,is_milestone}, surprise} with asset.versions length 1 and versions[0].image_b64 == the original image (previous pushed to history), new image_b64 different -> GET /api/assets/{id}/versions now shows the new current + 1 version with a version_id -> POST /api/assets/{id}/revert with that version_id swaps current<->previous (current becomes original image again, versions[0] becomes the outgoing regen image) -> POST /revert with bogus version_id -> 404. (4) Regression: /api/usage 401 without auth + shape {plan,generations_used,generations_limit,bonus_credits,counters,streak,unlocked,milestones} for demo; /api/projects 401 without auth + returns {projects:[...]} with demo's 3+ seeded projects each having id/title/status; /api/brand-kits 401 without auth + returns {brand_kits:[...]} for demo. Frontend (375x667 mobile viewport): (A) Demo login works via use-demo-button + auth-submit-button; welcome-explore-button dismisses cleanly. (B) Studio tab loads (route /studio): shows 'Branding Studio' header, 'New Brand Kit' CTA, Palette Generator + Templates tools, 'Brand Kits' section — demo account currently has 0 brand kits and 0 assets in this preview env, so a live asset-tile-<id> tap couldn't be exercised on demo. However the Asset Detail screen /asset/[id] mounts cleanly when navigated directly (verified with /asset/nonexistent-id-test): renders the header 'Asset · V1', asset-back button, image preview area, 'Export PNG' (asset-export), 'Refine this asset' section with asset-tweak-input placeholder 'Describe a change…' and 'Generate new version' button (asset-regenerate). asset-regenerate was intentionally NOT tapped (spec: demo is free-tier). (C) Paywall (/paywall) renders correctly on web: 'CreatorForge Premium' hero, plan-yearly ($149/yr, POPULAR, Save 17%) and plan-monthly ($14.99/mo), FEATURES list, paywall-close, paywall-restore-button, and subscribe-button with label 'Continue — $149/yr' (IAP_AVAILABLE=false on web -> Stripe path). No expo-iap crash. (D) OfflineBanner: component exists in /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx with testID 'offline-banner' and visibility gated by prop — confirmed NOT visible on Home, Studio or Paywall when online. Known RN-web deprecation warnings ('shadow* style props deprecated'; 'props.pointerEvents deprecated') still emitted — carry-over from iters 1-5, cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter 1-5: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warnings still emitted. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (Card/Button shadows).

Carry-over from iter 1-5: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still emitted (LinearGradient/overlay wrappers, and app/asset/[id].tsx watermark View pointerEvents="none" on lines 124 & 199).

action_items: OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter 1-5): migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents in ui.tsx and app/asset/[id].tsx (lines 124, 199 use pointerEvents="none" on a View wrapper for the watermark overlay).

OBSERVATION only — data condition, not a bug: the demo account in this preview env currently has 0 brand kits and 0 assets, so the Studio 'Brand Kits' section shows the 'No brand kits yet' empty state and the assets grid was empty. That prevented a real asset-tile-<id> tap-through in the demo flow. Not a code issue — the Asset Detail screen itself mounts fine when navigated to directly. If the main agent wants demo to showcase versioning UI, consider seeding a brand kit + 1 or 2 assets (with an existing versions entry) on demo during backend startup seeding.

MINOR: /app/frontend/app/asset/[id].tsx uses `versions.length + 1` in the header label to name the current version (e.g. 'Social · v3'). After a revert this can misrepresent the effective version # because revert swaps but does not decrement — cosmetic only, but consider a small note or renaming to 'Current' to avoid off-by-one confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py IAP_PRODUCTS mapping {pro.monthly->monthly, pro.yearly->yearly} matches frontend /app/frontend/src/constants/iap.ts PLAN_TO_PRODUCT + PRODUCT_TO_PLAN — consistent.

server.py verify_iap() correctly returns 503 for '*_not_configured' errors and 400 for validation failures (missing receipt / purchase_token / unknown product / invalid platform). Idempotency check via db.iap_transactions.transaction_id looks correct — early-return with already_active:true.

server.py regenerate_asset() calls check_and_count_generation before ai.generate_image and refund_generation on failure — quota-safe. Version history is capped by MAX_ASSET_VERSIONS=10, most-recent-first, watermark flag preserved per-version.

server.py revert_asset() does NOT consume a generation (spec-compliant), correctly pushes outgoing image into version history (LIFO cap 10) and returns fresh asset shape identical to regenerate (minus streak/surprise).

Frontend /app/frontend/src/components/IapPurchaseBar.tsx passes platform=Platform.OS to /iap/verify — on iOS storeKit2 the JWS is passed in both receipt and purchase_token fields to defensively handle server-side branching. IAP_AVAILABLE gate correctly excludes web + Expo Go.

Frontend /app/frontend/app/asset/[id].tsx correctly handles 402 (out of generations) by pushing /paywall, saves prior version to history via server (client only re-fetches via load()), and compare mode uses side-by-side CompareCell — no image-b64 leaks between screens.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for verifiable surfaces — paywall renders + testIDs correct, Asset Detail route mounts with all documented testIDs (asset-back / asset-tweak-input / asset-regenerate / asset-export), OfflineBanner hidden online, demo login/welcome flow works, Studio tab reachable. Live asset-tile tap could not be exercised because demo has no seeded assets (data condition, not a bug).

seed_data_creation: Created throwaway users during iter-6 backend tests (tester+iapunk_*, iapios1_*, iapios2_*, iapdroid_*, assetver_*@creatorforge.app). These remain in the DB but are TEST_-prefixed for easy cleanup. Demo account (demo@creatorforge.app) used only for read-only regression /usage /projects /brand-kits — no state modified. This iteration consumed exactly 2 image generations total (1 initial + 1 regenerate) inside TestAssetVersionHistory, plus 1 Claude palette auto-generation via the brand-kit auto_generate step. No UI-triggered image generations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-6 new/verified backend endpoints: (a) GET /api/payments/iap/products (public — no auth) returns {products:[{product_id, plan, name, amount}]} with pro.monthly@$14.99 & pro.yearly@$149. (b) POST /api/payments/iap/verify (auth) — body {platform:'ios'|'android', product_id, transaction_id?, purchase_token?, receipt?}; 503 for not_configured (empty APPLE_SHARED_SECRET or GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON), 400 for validation errors, 200 with {valid, plan, premium_until} on success (idempotent via db.iap_transactions.transaction_id). (c) GET /api/assets/{id}/versions (auth) returns {asset_id, type, current:{id:'current', image_b64, prompt, created_at, watermarked}, versions:[{id,image_b64,prompt,created_at,watermarked}, ...]}. (d) POST /api/assets/{id}/regenerate (auth, body {prompt?}) — consumes 1 image gen (402 if quota depleted), returns {asset, newly_unlocked, streak_event, surprise}. (e) POST /api/assets/{id}/revert (auth, body {version_id}) — free, returns {asset}, 404 for unknown version_id. Version cap MAX_ASSET_VERSIONS=10. Frontend new testIDs: asset-tile-<id> (Studio grid), history-asset-<id> (Brand Kit history), asset-back / asset-export / asset-tweak-input / asset-regenerate / version-<i> / compare-keep-current / compare-restore (Asset Detail), subscribe-button (paywall — Stripe path on web, IAP path via IapPurchaseBar on native), offline-banner (OfflineBanner component, visibility gated by 'visible' prop). Known cosmetic issues (carry-over): shadow* + pointerEvents RN-web deprecation warnings; header label 'v{versions.length+1}' on asset/[id].tsx becomes inaccurate after revert (off-by-one). Demo account has 0 seeded assets & brand kits in this preview env — main agent may want to seed one to demo the versioning UI end-to-end.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration-6 features. Note on frontend UI coverage: the review request said 'Tap a generated asset tile (testID asset-tile-<id>) OR from a Brand Kit tap history-asset-<id>' — demo has no assets or brand kits in this env so we validated the Asset Detail screen by direct navigation to /asset/<id> instead. All documented testIDs (asset-back, asset-tweak-input, asset-regenerate, asset-export) render correctly. This is a data limitation, not a code defect. The GO_BACK dev-warning that appears when the /asset/[id] screen is opened as the FIRST route (no prior history) is a normal expo-router dev-only warning.
